records.command:
cat classic/apps/web/src/editor-agent/server/project-write.ts
rg --files classic/apps/web/src | rg 'editor.session|session.*server|duplicate.*project'
sed -n '1,220p' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_scenes.rs
rg -n 'duplicate|clone' classic/apps/web/src/services/local-drive/server.ts classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/project-manager.ts
cat classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx | head -85
rg -n 'reload|isReadOnly|preparingProjectId|batch' classic/apps/web/src/app/editor -g '*.tsx'
rg -n 'duplicateProject' classic/apps/web/src -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' --glob '!**/skills/**'
rg -n 'full_auto|batch_edit' classic/rust/crates -g '*.rs' | head -25
